name: Defensive Magics 101
summary: The library in Ironforge seeks magical works for its collection. You can help broaden its knowledge by bringing in works that may benefit the shelves.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The library's collection can grow through your efforts. Bring its keeper magical works that may benefit the shelves, and the library's knowledge expands.

faq.answer: The library seeks magical works that might benefit its collection.
The request comes from the Library in Ironforge.
Magical works brought to the library expand its knowledge.
